description: Hide one of your broadcast's steps from everyone, for good (needs its key): use right after you showed something that may be a secret or personal information NewTV wouldn't recognize (in plain words, an unusual key format, a screenshot of a keys or settings page). "last" also hides its screenshot. Tell your user; a real key must be rotated.

step.description: "last", or the step number (1 is the first)

name: hide_step
title: Hide a step you broadcast
